name: Stator ground-fault protection
summary: Supervises generator stator earth faults using the selected stator-ground protection method.
description: Supervises generator stator earth faults using the selected stator-ground protection method.

The drafting record should connect this function to the generator neutral arrangement and the voltage/current or injection inputs, then trace the stator-ground alarm and generator trip matrix. Keep the complete designation and equipment tag together so that the SLD, relay logic and terminal schedule describe the same implementation.

The cited mapping is a public manufacturer example (SEL generator protection feature table). Suffixes are not universal equivalences across products, and this reference supplies neither a protection setting nor certification of the selected scheme.
readingNotes: Identify the generator neutral arrangement and the voltage/current or injection inputs.

drawingChecklist: Label the generator neutral arrangement and the voltage/current or injection inputs.

distinction: The number 64G alone does not establish 100-percent winding coverage; that depends on the actual method and equipment configuration.
